name: Tripledot Games
location: London, UK / Barcelona, Spain / Warsaw, Poland
description: Our flagship studio and the heart of the Tripledot group. We build casual puzzle games that have become some of the most-played mobile titles in the world — Woodoku alone has been downloaded hundreds of millions of times. If you love obsessing over product quality and working with some of the sharpest minds in mobile gaming, this is your home.
culture: We move fast and care deeply about craft. Our culture is data-obsessed but genuinely collaborative — we take the work seriously without taking ourselves too seriously. You'll be surrounded by people who challenge you to do your best work every day.

name: Ludios
description: Our APAC studio, led by Tripledot co-founder Eyal Chameides. Based across Melbourne and Jakarta, we build casual puzzle games with a genuine passion for craft and player experience. Eyal has shipped dozens of titles across his career and that depth of game design expertise runs through everything we do.
culture: We're creative and craft-led, with a strong sense of ownership at every level. You'll have real autonomy over your work, a team that trusts you to deliver, and a founder who genuinely cares about building great games.
unique: We combine the creative sensibility of an indie studio with Tripledot's world-class data infrastructure. That means our games feel handcrafted — because they are — but they're also rigorously optimised for real players at scale.

name: PeopleFun
description: Our word games studio, based in Dallas. We're home to Wordscapes — one of the most beloved word games ever made, with hundreds of millions of downloads and a passionate global audience. If you want to work on a product that genuinely matters to people, this is the place.
culture: We're collaborative and remote-friendly, with a genuine love for word games and a strong sense of product ownership. We make decisions with data but we never forget that great games require creative instinct too.
unique: We've built and sustained one of the most beloved casual game franchises in mobile history. Wordscapes has a loyal player base that keeps coming back year after year — and we're still finding new ways to grow and innovate on top of that foundation.

name: Lion Studios
description: Our hyper-casual and hybrid-casual studio, operating across the US and Berlin. unique: We have a rare and proven ability to take a simple concept and scale it into a global hit. Our track record speaks for itself — and we're always looking for the next one.

name: Machine Zone

name: Athena Studio

name: Zephyr Mobile
description: Our casual puzzle studio within the Tripledot Games family. We focus on classic puzzle formats reimagined for modern mobile players — testing rapidly, iterating constantly, and building games that genuinely delight.

name: Zenlife Games
description: Our casual and word games studio, operating across China and Singapore. Formerly Zenjoy, we've built deep expertise in building games that work across Eastern and Western markets simultaneously — something very few studios have genuinely cracked.

unique: We've solved something genuinely hard: building games that resonate deeply with very different audiences at the same time. That cross-cultural product expertise is rare and it's at the core of everything we build.
